meta.note: Colours, spacing and radii come from the source; the type pairing (Wix Madefor Display + Cormorant Garamond) was chosen by the owner on 2026-11-01 for the landing redesign.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background of the landing. Everything light sits on it.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised panels on `surface`: FAQ items, cards, device frames' screens. From the cabinet's light theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on `surface` and `card` (15.5:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface` (4.6:1) and `card` (5.0:1): subheads, captions, FAQ answers. Not on `bg` (3.7:1, below 4.5).

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders on `surface`/`card`. Decorative only: 1.2:1, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The accent word in headlines (`accent-word`), active states, focus rings, icons in cards. On `surface` as text: 3.4:1, so only 24px+ (headline accent words qualify). White text on it is 3.8:1: not for buttons.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (white text 6.7:1), links and small accent text on `surface` (6.1:1). Matches the logo's deep blue.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent on the navy bands: links and highlights on `bg` (7.8:1).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Navy bands: header, footer, the lead-form block. Text on it is `surface` (16.8:1) or white at 70–80% for secondary lines.

tokens.name: bg-soft
tokens.usage: Inputs and inset panels inside a `bg` band.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and input borders inside `bg` bands.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status dots and the «Доставлено» state, always with a word next to it. 3.2:1 on white: icon or bold 19px+ only.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: «Нет данных» and waiting states, always with a word. 2.7:1 on white: use as a dot or as a fill under an `ink` label, never as text on white.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Form errors under a field (5.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: logo-blue
tokens.usage: Logo only (the left arm of the Y). Do not use as a UI colour; `accent-deep` is the UI twin.

tokens.name: logo-teal
tokens.usage: Logo only (the right arm of the Y).

tokens.name: logo-pin
tokens.usage: Logo only (the location pin). Not a UI accent.

families.display: "Wix Madefor Display", "Golos Text", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The first-screen headline at desktop width; in code `clamp(48px, 8.5vw, 120px)`.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headlines at desktop width; in code `clamp(34px, 5vw, 64px)`.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and block titles inside a section.

styles.name: accent-word
styles.usage: One word or short phrase per headline, in `accent`. Set inside the headline at 1.12em of its size, so Cormorant's small x-height matches the grotesk. Never for body text or below 32px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Водитель ставит приложение, вы видите весь рейс.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Телефон водителя записывает путь и присылает его целиком.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Ссылку можно отозвать в любой момент.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and form labels (`font-mono text-xs tracking-widest uppercase`).

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Times, routes and numbers shown as product data.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label, between stacked buttons on a phone.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside small groups (badge rows, form label to field).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between related blocks; minimum side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side padding (`.container-page` padding-inline 1.25rem).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between columns of a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (`py-20`).

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width (`.container-page`).

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs (`rounded-[10px]`).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Small cards and icon tiles (`rounded-xl`).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, FAQ items, video frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, status chips, the language switcher.

shadow.note: The source defines one shadow, `--shadow-glow`, as `0 10px 60px -20px` with a `color-mix()` of `accent` at 35%; written here with that mix resolved to rgba.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Under the primary button and the hero video frame only.
